name: Nader Motee
title: Professor; Director, Autonomous and Intelligent Robotics Laboratory
fitReason: Strong safe-autonomy overlap through online scene representations and control that actively improves perception while constraining physical navigation.

physicalEvidence.summary: Splat-CBF (September 19, 2026 preprint), by three Lehigh MEM authors including Motee, explicitly evaluates a physical Ackermann-steered mobile robot with an online 3D Gaussian Splatting map. Section V-D reports a 28.2-meter executed route and closed-loop safety/perception arbitration. Section V-E’s Kinova Gen3 is explicitly simulated in Isaac Sim, not physical-arm evidence. Robot brand, ownership and complete sensor inventory were not specified in the reviewed hardware section.

shortVisit.summary: No current external short-visit invitation was verified from the official faculty and institute lab pages. Lehigh’s new 2026 humanoid/quadruped Impact Fellowship is a student project description, not evidence of external-master’s summer eligibility. Linked DCDS homepage redirects to generic Arts and Sciences content, and the AIR WordPress site failed retrieval.

scoreReasons.fit: Direct safe active perception and learned 3D scene representation, though not primarily policy RL.
scoreReasons.physical: Detailed current own-institution physical mobile-robot section; limited platform/sensor identification merits less than maximum.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: No current external visitor pathway verified; student-training project alone is insufficient.
scoreReasons.freshness: September 2026 full preprint with hardware methods plus current official faculty/institute listings.
